offering_description.value: Builds and sells single-family homes, townhomes, and condominiums to homebuyers in planned communities. It generally buys finished lots from developers, builds homes using subcontractors and components from its own plants, and offers buyers mortgage and title services.

primary_services.value: Residential mortgage origination; title and settlement services

customer_segment.value: B2C: First-time, move-up, and luxury homebuyers; B2B: Secondary-market purchasers of originated residential mortgages

end_markets.value: New residential housing; residential mortgage lending; real estate title and settlement

revenue_model.value: product sales: New homes sold to individual buyers; other: Sales of originated residential mortgages to secondary-market purchasers; service fees: Mortgage origination, title, and settlement charges; interest or premiums: Interest on originated mortgages held pending sale
revenue_model.category: product sales; other; service fees; interest or premiums

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Uses finished lots, building materials, and subcontracted labor to build homes for individual buyers; financial intermediary: Originates mortgages for homebuyers and sells the loans to secondary-market purchasers; service provider: Uses property and loan records to provide title and closing services to buyers
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; financial intermediary; service provider

geography_served.value: US regional: Mid-Atlantic, Northeast, Midwest, and Southeast United States

specialization.value: related lines: New-home construction and sales, mortgage origination, and title and settlement for homebuyers

distribution_channels.value: own locations: Model homes and sales centers in residential communities; direct sales: In-house home sales teams and affiliated mortgage loan officers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Mortgage and title licensing, federal consumer lending rules, and local zoning and building codes
